message.content: Caelum mentioned "The Legend of Zelda: Skyward Sword HD" as a game that takes advantage of its music to enhance the emotional engagement with the narrative. Specifically, Caelum noted how the fresh orchestral arrangements breathe new life into the game, enhancing the sense of atmosphere and making every boss encounter feel even more epic. This aligns with the broader discussion about how music can significantly amplify the emotional impact of a game's storytelling.
